title: Centre Bounce Positioning (Chas McIvor)
style: country swing bluegrass banjo brass bongo fast beat 132bpm comedy dad voice spoken interjections southern drawl harmonica steel guitar fiddle
lyrics:
[Intro - Chas spoken]
Son, the centre bounce, that is where games begin
Before the tap, before the ball, your positioning wins

[Verse 1]
Arc your run from the boundary side
Cut through the space as the ruck jumps high
Pre-position for the tap two beats ahead
Read your ruckmans shoulder, that is how the tap is read

Centre arc to the pocket when the tap goes back
Wing position when the tap goes to the flank
Straight possession when the tap comes down
Centre bounce positioning rules this ground

[Pre-Chorus]
Read the ruck, read the arc
Know your role before the spark
Centre bounce, start the game right
Pre-positioned from the morning light

[Chorus]
Centre bounce, position wins
Arc the run before it begins
Read the tap two beats before
Centre bounce, that is what the game is for

[Verse 2]
Four midfielders, four roles at the bounce
The runner, the crumber, the tagger, and the ounce
Know which role is yours before the ump calls time
Undefined roles at the bounce, that costs every dime

[Bridge]
Bluey: They are setting up beautifully at the centre bounce, structure on display
Trevor: The arc pre-positioning shows a well-drilled midfield, credit to the coaching staff
Chas: Credit to THIS coaching staff Trev. Right here. This one.

[Chorus]
Centre bounce, position wins
Arc the run before it begins
Read the tap two beats before
Centre bounce, that is what the game is for

[Outro]
Structure before the bounce son
Thats my boy
